snapshot.description: Sanitized snapshot of the producer package, numerical producer scripts, and tests used for the v7 audit.
snapshot.authoritative_identity: The artifact/code file entries in artifact/RESULTS.sha256 identify the exact released source snapshot.
snapshot.working_tree_status: The v7 producer snapshot contained working-tree changes beyond its last commit; no repository commit is claimed to identify this release.
snapshot.repository_identifier_policy: Withheld for double-blind review; the complete source snapshot needed by this artifact is included directly.

release_adjustments.change: Normalized the four variant labels and made the producer run both s=0 and the requested planted level, then emit the released level-centered recovery schema. The pre-release single-level script could not reproduce that artifact and is not claimed as its execution identity.
Replaced one workstation-specific example checkpoint path with a role-based placeholder; executable statements are unchanged.

Replaced stale pre-v7 module and inline commentary with the released conditional-null, external-H0, factor-spectrum, and operational-participation-ratio semantics; removed quantitative generative-null claims traced to an invalid no-complement exploratory implementation; executable statements are unchanged.
Replaced machine-layout assumptions with explicit code, cache, seed-root, and revision-record arguments; the scientific exact-overlap arguments are unchanged.
Requires immutable dataset revisions from upstream_revisions.json and fails closed on incomplete source pools.

Added fail-closed checks for the upstream revision record and archived Arrow-shard hashes, and constructed the path-scan markers without embedding workstation prefixes; sampling and materialization are unchanged.

Recomputes A-right, B-left, and BA-right overlap from all 16 pinned adapter checkpoints. The primary estimand uses all 24 targeted q/v modules; the historical layers-2/6/10 subset is retained only as an explicitly labelled secondary provenance diagnostic.
Changed only result creation from overwrite to exclusive-create mode; the diagnostic computation is unchanged.

Kept the evaluated projection, prompts, deterministic sampling, and accuracy computation, while replacing stale claims and unpinned repository HEADs with immutable base, specialist, and dataset revisions; output creation now refuses overwrite.
Pools the four shipped independent LoRA-null batches and reproduces both canonical pooled CSVs byte for byte.
Replaced causal attribution language with the released conditional-null reproduction interpretation; executable statements are unchanged.
Replaced one ambiguous legacy term with reuse; executable statements are unchanged.

deliberate_omissions.item: large model weights, activation-covariance tensors, fold tensors, and sensitivity cell caches
deliberate_omissions.reason: They are not needed for the offline numerical audit; immutable upstream revisions and compact output fingerprints are shipped instead.

deliberate_omissions.item: individual-example merge-evaluation logits and source images
deliberate_omissions.reason: The compact bundle ships all per-task accuracies and their pinned evaluator, which is sufficient to audit the table aggregation; repeating model forward passes requires the pinned public inputs.

deliberate_omissions.item: internal stale number-check and figure-rendering scripts
deliberate_omissions.reason: The release-level standard-library checker is analysis/check_paper_numbers.py; stale internal scripts could silently validate superseded values.
